title: Run a 70B parameter AI on a 4GB GPU using RLLM’s layer-by-layer method. #AI #Tech #OpenSource
description:
RLLM enables running a 70 billion parameter AI model on a graphics card with only four gigabytes of VRAM by loading the model one layer at a time, rather than all at once. This approach significantly reduces the required GPU memory from over 100 gigabytes, making large-scale AI models accessible on commonly available, lower-spec hardware. While performance is slower, it opens up experimentation opportunities with powerful open source models to a wider audience including researchers and students without the need for expensive GPU setups. This solution addresses a critical barrier in AI development—high hardware demand—by optimizing model loading and memory usage. Its ability to democratize access to large AI models promotes broader innovation and learning, making advanced AI more inclusive and affordable for diverse users. #AI #MachineLearning #RLLM
#DeepLearning #GPUs #OpenSourceAI #TechInnovation #ArtificialIntelligence #AIResearch #LowVRAMAI #AIModels #Technology #FutureTech #AIForEveryone #Computing
